title: An Honest Heart Is Light
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The king sat at a happy feast
With cups of shining gold;
Then fingers wrote upon the wall,
And all the room went cold.

[Chorus]
An honest heart is light, so light,
It skips and sings along;
I'll tell the truth, the plain, plain truth,
And sing a happy song.

[Verse 2]
No wise man there could read the words,
The king began to shake;
The queen said, "Daniel knows the way,
He'll read them for your sake."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
"A robe of red, a chain of gold!"
The king held out the prize;
"Keep all your gifts," brave Daniel said,
And spoke with honest eyes.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
When Wren's friend got the blame one day,
Her tummy felt so tight;
"It was me," said Wren right out loud,
And then her heart felt light.

[Chorus]
mood: Upright, open music. A small string quartet keeps a plain, even step under the voice, a little hushed and held in the first verses while the hand writes on the wall. At Daniel's answer the knot loosens: the cello settles onto one steady open chord and the violins lift off it. Each chorus is lighter on its feet, plucked strings skipping under the words, ending clear and unburdened like a breath let out in the middle of the day.
